description: Create a CoinVello hosted checkout session (an invoice plus a payment page at pay.coinvello.com). Redirect the customer to the returned `url`. Amounts are decimal strings. `currency` is an ISO code (USD, EUR...) or an asset id to price in crypto. Fulfil orders from the invoice.paid webhook, never from the redirect.

accepted_assets.description: Assets the customer may pay with; defaults to all assets with an enabled wallet.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as USD/EUR/GBP, or an asset id such as btc:bitcoin.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key per order so retries do not create duplicate sessions, e.g. order-123-checkout.

metadata.description: Up to 50 string key/value pairs returned on the object and in webhooks.

order_id.description: Your order reference; indexed and searchable.

redirect_on.description: When the hosted page redirects to success_url (default confirming).

success_url.description: Where the hosted page sends the customer after payment.

tax.description: The tax portion of the sale as you computed it, in the invoice currency and included in `amount` (e.g. {"amount":"7.98","rate":"0.19","label":"VAT 19%","jurisdiction":"DE"}); copied to the records and exports. jurisdiction is a code you choose, never anything about the payer.

name: create_checkout_session
title: Create a hosted checkout session
